cases.title: Solving years-old math problems with Gemini 2.5 Deep Think
focus_rules: AI reasoning and mathematical research: reliability, human verification, and test-time exploration

timed_segments.text: With my most recent experience
with Gemini Deep Think,
the answer was spectacular.
This is a mathematical conjecture that was made by some people, some years ago.
They didn't manage to prove it back then.
They checked many cases and then they just left it as a conjecture.
I asked the statement of the conjecture to Gemini Deep Think
and it seems like it proved it right away
with a completely different method.
When I was thinking about solving that question,
I was thinking about maybe three different things, three different ideas,
but it seems that Deep Think was thinking about 20 or 100.
Many, many different possibilities and then pursuing them.
The Deep Think mode that users will get access to
is basically very similar to the Deep Think mode that we used
to acheive the gold-medal standard at the IMO.
So, the achievement of IMO is a major milestone in artificial intelligence,
towards building human-level intelligence.

Still needs human mathematical verification and broader evaluation
